candidate.definition_en: To force someone to have sex against their will.
candidate.explanation_ar: يغتصب؛ أي يعتدي على شخص جنسياً بالإكراه ودون موافقته.

senses.definition_en: To force someone to have sex against their will, especially using violence or threats.
senses.definition_ar: إجبار شخص على ممارسة الجنس رغماً عنه، خاصةً باستخدام العنف أو التهديد.
examples: He was convicted of attempting to rape a student.
Under the law, it is a severe crime to rape someone.
The commander warned the soldiers not to rape or loot in captured territory.
